newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia sees window of opportunity from the Euro.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia sees window of opportunity from the Euro.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Tuesday the creation of a single European currency opened new opportunities for the country.
Leaders from the European Union countries agreed on Monday at a summit in Amsterdam to proceed with the single currency after some hurdles with the stability pact were addressed.
"From the point of view of Indonesia, a window of opportunity is opening," Djiwandono said at a meeting on the Euro organised by the ABN-Amro Bank in Jakarta.
Djiwandono said the Euro market met many of the criteria used by the Indonesian government in its traditional approach to financial and capital markets such as pragmatism and prudence.

He said if Indonesia were to approach the Euro market it would be to diversify its sources of funds and also to diversify its currency reserves and to match its liabilities or to swap the Euros into dollars.
Djiwandono said the single currency should lead Indonesia to consider its export currency and also implications for its future asset and liability management.
"One can hope that the creation of this large market will contribute to more investments in and increased capital flows to Indonesia," Djiwandono said.
